jobs.title: Engineer, Field Process - Taiwan (Hsinchu|Taichung|Tainan|Kaoshiung)
jobs.description:
**Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture.**


For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what's next, at the forefront of innovation and what's technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we're more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.


**Job's Mission**



ASM is recruiting for Field Process Engineer in our ALD/EPI/PEALD/CVD/CMP business function Taiwan. As part of a team, You'll be the engineer customers call when something on the recipe isn't behaving, and the one who finds the answer.

  


**Location:** Hsinchu, Taichung, Tainan, or Kaohsiung *(you will be able to indicate your preferred work location when submitting your application.)*



**What you will be working on**


* Developing and optimizing unit processes (ALD, PEALD, Epitaxy, furnace, or PECVD) on assigned applications
* Owning day\-to\-day customer requests on a single product/film: scoping the issue, running the experiment, presenting the result
* Designing and executing Design of Experiments (DOEs) to validate new technology performance and accelerate readiness for high\-volume manufacturing (HVM)
* Validating tool performance and feeding structured findings back to Product Management to improve the product
* Implementing Best Known Methods (BKMs) and documenting qualification results so the team gets faster every cycle
* Bringing innovative ideas to recipe tuning and staying current with the state of the art
* Identifying safety risks on the tool and helping train newer engineers on safe execution


**What we are looking for**



* MS in Chemica
